converted: "A-Reverb": Reverb (as Fruity Reeverb 2) → mixer insert 11, with their settings.
"B-Delay": Delay (as Fruity Delay 3) → mixer insert 12, with their settings.
Mixer: 1 group and 2 returns routed as in Live.
"KICK (MIDI)": 8 extra plugin outputs → the mixer inserts of the tracks that took them in Live.
"KICK (MIDI)": MIDI devices baked into the notes — routed through 56 key zones, as they played in Live.
MIDI devices: 1 track had its notes shaped the way Live's MIDI devices shaped them (FL has no equivalents to load).
warnings: Install these plugins for FL Studio before opening the project: Kontakt 8. Any that are missing will show FL's "plugin not found" message.
